blocks.text: Taylor Swift has released “The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore,” an extended version of her 12th studio album, featuring four new songs including the track “Patient Zero.” The collection, released on Friday, Sept. 25, also includes “Cleveland!,” “Pink Clouding” and “Babylon.” The extended version was released almost a year after the original album premiered in October 2025. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Taylor Swift (@taylorswift) Prior to the unveiling of the tracks, Swift also teased through her Instagram page the official music video of “Patient Zero,” which stars Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell.
